simple.meaning: בֶּרֶד (Bered) is a Hebrew word meaning “Bered , the name of a place south of Palestine, also of an Israelite.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בֶּרֶד (H1260) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 16:14, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בֶּרֶד (H1260) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בֶּרֶד (H1260) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בֶּרֶד (Bered) / H1260 is traced through Genesis 16:14, 1 Chronicles 7:20 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: Bered , the name of a place south of Palestine, also of an Israelite
definitions.full: H1260. Bered בֶּ֫רֶד 1. proper name, of a location בָּ֑רֶד Gen 16:14 near Kadesh. 2. proper name, masculine בֶּ֫רֶד an Ephraimite 1Chr 7:20 .

occurrences.englishText: Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi.* Beer Lahai Roi means “well of the one who lives and sees me”. Behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
